name: plugin-toolkit
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project plugin-toolkit --web

metadata.description: Stamp the workspace version into the plugin author CLI, as the default `bge-plugin --bge-version` (#1093). The output is gitignored; build, typecheck and test run this first.

build.// inputs: The list @nx/js/typescript infers, plus the generated TypeScript itself (the last entry, which hashes generate's output). bge-version.ts is gitignored, so without it a workspace version bump keeps this task's hash and restores a dist whose default --bge-version is the old version (#1093). An explicit inputs list replaces the inferred one, so re-derive it after an @nx/js upgrade. See docs/NX_CACHING.md.

typecheck.// inputs: The list @nx/js/typescript infers, plus the generated TypeScript itself (the last entry, which hashes generate's output), for the reason given on build. See docs/NX_CACHING.md.

test.// inputs: The list @nx/jest infers, plus the generated TypeScript itself (the last entry, which hashes generate's output): the specs compare against the stamped BGE_VERSION, so a version bump must re-run them rather than replay a cached pass (#1093). See docs/NX_CACHING.md.
